## Checklist

- [ ] Branch named `imperix/vrx-XX-slug` (with an issue) or `imperix/<slug>`
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (e.g. `feat(vrx-XX): ...`, or `feat: ...` without an issue)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` (includes typecheck) all pass locally
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, or PII logged; no hardcoded paths
- [ ] PR description explains what changed and links the issue, if any
